brand.name: Orient
brand.notes: Pakistani brand (Orient Electronics, Lahore; BlueEast operations). AC lines: Cooltron, Smartron / Smartron Plus, Ecotron, Ultron / Ultron Plus, Megatron, Gigatron, QG, AUX-sourced lines, Premier floor-standing, Vibe/AK. Support UAN: 0800-ORIENT (0800-11635). No public Orient service manual PDF; official error table lived on orient.com.pk blog (17 Jun 2020) and now redirects — recovered via Internet Archive. AUX is an Orient OEM partner: AUX-published tables resemble Orient on many entries but are not Orient-badged (see docs/sources/orient.md).
